note: Frontend releases ship as an ordered chain under fe/: patches.json, then patches-2.json … patches-N.json. Each file is exact string replacements on the previous result, gated by baseSha256 (must equal the prior expectedSha256, or the repo index.html sha for file 1) and expectedSha256 (result). srv-boot.js patches server.js first; the effective server applies this FE chain at boot (in-memory + gzip). Cap is currently scanned through patches-100. Any failure serves the repo index.html unchanged. Live state: GET /api/fe-info. New release = add fe/patches-(N+1).json only — do not edit index.html or earlier patch files. Consolidation: upload a fully patched index.html, reset fe/patches.json to {"patches":[]}, and delete fe/patches-2…N in the same release.
